tbesh_html:
Month of exodus and passover (March or April)
Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212)
This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley

strongs_1890.strongs_def: green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to be tender);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).
